claims.sentence: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effect of ezetimibe coadministered with simvastatin compared with simvastatin alone when administered for 12 weeks on endothelial function as assessed by brachial artery reactivity testing (BART) using high-frequency ultrasound to image the brachial artery vasomotor response to a flow-mediated stimulus (high-shear stress) in subjects with high cholesterol.
